narr: A very moist airmass and slow moving storms led to a multi-day heavy rainfall event for much of the area. 6 to 8+ inches fell in a swath from southwest OK northeast along the I-44 corridor. Several storms also produced isolated severe weather with hail and strong winds reported.
ev: Six to eight inches of fast moving water over the road at 24th and Lamar by Riverwind casino.
Six to eight inches of water crossing the roads in town at several locations.
Several reports of flash flooding across the county with road closures on Highway 18 north/south out of Chandler and at Highway 66/177.
Multiple stalled cars from flooded roadways.
Multiple intersections closed in town with one water rescue performed. Some apartments evacuated due to high water.
